programme.title: Ear Wax Elf / Stunter's Block
programme.desc: Howie must be extra nice to his pals so that the Ear Wax Elf will leave him a gift for his latest blob of wax. Then, Howie quits the hotel biz to try to lure his hero Dirk Danger out of retirement.

programme.title: When Suzi Attacks
programme.desc: When Suzi gets bit by the green eyed jealousy bug, she literally turns green with envy. Then, McGee adopts a fire-breathing dragon named Lizzy who proves to be an unruly pet.

programme.title: What Would Batty Do?
programme.desc: When Howie injures Batty in a stunting accident, he takes over as Poodle's assistant while Batty recuperates at the Banana Cabana. Then, thinking he has psychic predictive powers, Poodle kidnaps Duck.

programme.title: Hiccups
programme.desc: When things start disappearing around Lakebottom, the campers quickly realise McGee's hiccups are the cause. Then, McGee reads a storybook to help Squirt overcome his childhood fear.

programme.title: Employee Of The Month For Life / Saliva Drive
programme.desc: Howie does everyone's jobs - to help him decide who should be Employee of the Month. Then, Howie and the staff collect saliva for Octo, whose tongue has dried up.

programme.title: Fright Club
programme.desc: The campers discover an enchanted flashlight and exchange particularly disturbing tales about the Dripper. Then, McStanger inhabits a post-apocalyptic world.

programme.title: Veggie Beast / Hurricane Seasoning
programme.desc: Howie has to save the hotel from an overgrown, animal-swallowing plant. Then, a condiment storm is coming, and all of Howie's pals are trapped outside.

programme.title: The Day Squirt Stood Still
programme.desc: The campers track down a UFO inhabited by an alien from the planet Squipiter. Then, McGee and Buttsquat argue over who's a better space captain.

programme.title: Act To The Future / Guess Who's Coming To Lunch
programme.desc: To avoid being in Bunny's play, Howie and Octo attempt to travel into the future! Then, Piggy has to complete his final ninjitsu-chef test and defeat a spicy goulash!

programme.title: Smells Like Holidays
programme.desc: On the eve of Eekmas, McGee blames his toot on Squirt and is visited by three ghosts looking to save Camp Lakebottom. Then, the kids almost ruin the biggest monster holiday of the year!

programme.title: All Dog No Danger / Cowboy Cabana
programme.desc: Howie is kicked out of the Dirk Danger fan club and needs to find a new hero. Then, the Banana Cabana is visited by Burt and Burt - two gassy bulls who just want to trash the joint.

programme.title: Last Days
programme.desc: Looking to save Camp Lakebottom from being overtaken by the Grim Camper, McGee tries to prove how awesome Lakebottom really is. Then, the Bottom Dwellers come across a suitcase in the attic.

programme.title: Oh Brother, Who Art Thou?
programme.desc: Howie's 'long-lost brother' shows up to claim his half of the hotel. Then, Bunny organises a scavenger hunt but accidentally offers up the hotel as the prize.

programme.title: Duh'rekah
programme.desc: While chasing his gopher-nemesis, Sawyer gets zapped into his brain bin and emerges super smart! Then, McGee takes over the Lakebottom chores when Rosebud heads to the spa.

programme.title: A Fish This Big / Fizz Fuzz Bang
programme.desc: Howie is treated like a hero for saving a squirrel when really the squirrel saved him! Then, Poodle attacks the Banana Cabana with Cap'N Fizzy's pirate ship - it's up to Howie to stop her.

programme.title: Ice Queen
programme.desc: The campers try to reclaim their stolen Lakebottom items. Then, the campers convince Armand to protect his old spy nemesis, Abomina Lafur.

programme.title: Better Safe And Sorry / Narwhal's Contest
programme.desc: Octo the safety monitor tries to make the Banana Cabana TOO safe - with dangerous results! Then, Narwhal's biggest fan wins a 'spend a day with Narwhal' contest - but she ends up falling for Howie!

programme.title: Tooth Troll
programme.desc: Squirt is captured by a Tooth Troll who claims his baby tooth has enough power to summon all the teeth in the world. Then, Gretchen grows into a Queen Bee.

programme.title: Cool Paw Howie / S.S. Banana Cabana
programme.desc: Looking for a new challenge, Howie converts the hotel into a minimum security prison. After an unexpected toilet mishap, the Banana Cabana winds up floating on the high seas - becoming a 'boatel'!

programme.title: Head 2 Head
programme.desc: Suzi and Gretchen get fused into a two-headed Gruzi! Then, Armand and the campers venture into the Petrifying Forest.

programme.title: Robo Howie / The Old Act
programme.desc: Poodle builds a robot Howie and uses it to try to take over the Banana Cabana. Then, Narwhal's obnoxious old partner shows up - and wants to put the old act back together again.

programme.title: Slugfight
programme.desc: The campers must travel back in time to the old west to prevent Grandpappy Black Butt from stealing the deed to Lakebottom. Then, McGee gives Sawyer a high-tech chip that turns him into a Zomborg.

programme.title: Jellyhead / Matter Over Mind
programme.desc: A bossy Jellyfish sticks himself to Octo's head and starts to take over Octo's personality. Then, Howie gets the TV remote stuck to his head, and develops strange new powers!

programme.title: Sweat, Hot Lakebottom Summer
programme.desc: McGee becomes a human sweat hydrant after using zombie Sawye'rs anti-sweat cream! Then, McGee gets covered in delicious s'mores toppings, and is transformed into a s'mores monster! A S'Mogre!

programme.title: The Sun Howie Always Wanted
programme.desc: After several days of bad weather, Duck builds an artificial sun that never goes down. Then, Narwhal confesses his greatest secret ever... he never learned how to swim!

programme.title: Camp Lockdownbottom
programme.desc: Rosebud turns Camp Lakebottom into Camp LOCKDOWN-bottom! Then, Squirt develops a case of worms so bad, they try to EAT all of the Bottomdwellers!

programme.title: Gone Banana / Imaginary Fiend
programme.desc: When the hotel's rooftop banana goes missing, Howie and Octo set out on an island-wide adventure to find it. Then, Howie's old imaginary friend comes to visit and drives everyone crazy.

programme.title: Meet The Gretch's Parents
programme.desc: Gretch's famous action-hero, movie-star parents visit Camp Lakebottom, and wind up getting a dramatic motivation they never dreamed of. Then, the kids discover an inter-dimensional portal.

programme.title: Who Inked The Bed? / Kikmee
programme.desc: Octo's scary dreams have him staining his bedsheets in the shape of his pals. Then, Howie challenges Bunny that she can't get through a day without losing her temper.

programme.title: Lakebo-tron
programme.desc: Buttsquat and McGee get digitised into a classic 80's video game. Then, the Bottomdwellers travel through the interdimensional porta to an all-Sasquatch version of Camp Lakebottom.

programme.title: Candid Camaraderie / May The Best Loser Win
programme.desc: Poodle tries to humiliate the staff at the Banana Cabana by posting embarrassing videos of them online. Then, Octo's unable to set a record in Cap'n Fizzy's Big Book of Unnecessary Accomplishments.

programme.title: McGee's First Flush
programme.desc: The campers face the wrath of two mutated Ocean Apes, once the pets of McGee and Suzi, now seeking for revenge after being flushed years ago. Then, Squirt's ear wax gains its own consciousness!

programme.title: Piggy Party / Living Dangerously
programme.desc: Howie and the gang try to throw a surprise Mud Day party for a very suspicious Piggy. Then, Howie becomes a product tester for Dirk Danger's line of extremely hazardous merchandise.

programme.title: Butt-Squad
programme.desc: Buttsquat uses all the evil tricks at his disposal to brainwash the kids into becoming an elite Butt-Squad of Buttsquat warriors! Then, an alien ship invades Camp Lakebottom.

programme.title: The Orange Fizzy Blues / Champion Gurgitator
programme.desc: Howie needs to collect all of the puzzle pieces to win an exclusive, limited edition can of Cap'n Fizzy's Fuzzy Orange Soda. Then, Howie comes out of 'retirement' to avenge Piggy.

programme.title: I, Rodent
programme.desc: Rosebud and the kids are drawn into a Squirrel-version of Lakebottom to answer for their crimes against all Squirrel-kind! Then, McGee's nightmare of being seen in only his undies becomes reality!

programme.title: Piggy's Secret / Sloth Unleashed
programme.desc: Howie and Octo try to find out why Piggy's behaving so mysteriously. Then, Howie attempts to train Sloth to be a stunter so she can join the Dirk Danger fan club.

programme.title: Afterlife of the Party
programme.desc: The kids must halt all partying at once, lest they summon the Party Animal to Lakebottom. Then, the kids befriend a lost circus elephant.

programme.title: Stink Dog / Doll Pox
programme.desc: Howie decides bathing is a waste of time so his friends are forced to attempt a 'stinkervention.' Then, Howie tries to get the chicken pox so he can join the rest of the gang in quarantine.

programme.title: The Lakebottom House of Horrors! Mwa Ha Ha!
programme.desc: The kids enter a Lakebottom House of Horrors! Only to discover that they will soon be the house's star attractions!

programme.title: Cat's Eight Lives / Crouching Narwhal, Hidden Piggy
programme.desc: Cat trades 8 of his 9 lives for Howie's old TV - but now he needs them back... but where did Howie put them? Then, Narwhal competes with Piggy on a ninjitsu-chef game show.

programme.title: Tur-keepin It Real
programme.desc: The kids must find their way out of a Lakebottom dimension populated by giant Turkeysaurus Rexes. Then, McGee is desperate to get Santa Claus OUT of Lakebottom, after he crash-lands in camp!

programme.title: Howiewe'en / Hotel of Horrors
programme.desc: Octo tries to embrace the scariest night of the year - Howiewe'en - and goes too far. Then, Howie uses the haunted bathroom in the basement and is sucked into a very freaky world.

programme.title: Nostril-Damus!
programme.desc: McGee's toxic-rain induced cold causes his snot to attain future-telling powers! Then, the kids discover that Slimey is secretly hanging out with the Bottomlukers.

programme.title: Howiewe'en / Hotel of Horrors
programme.desc: Octo tries to embrace the scariest night of the year - Howiewe'en - and goes too far. Then, Howie uses the haunted bathroom in the basement and is sucked into a very freaky world.

programme.title: The Perfect Gift / Home for the Howiedays
programme.desc: Howie and the gang can't open their presents until Narwhal gets there... Where is he?! Then, Poodle and Batty reluctantly spend the Howiedays at the Banana Cabana.

programme.title: The Old Man and the McGee
programme.desc: Middle-aged McGee travels from the future back to present-day Lakebottom to change the past. Then, the whole Lakebottom gang travels to McGee's town to find out what happened to his parents.

programme.title: The Cabana Manana / Howie's Little Helper
programme.desc: Howie and the gang try to convince Yeti that their hotel is too weird for him. Then, a young Chipmunk goes power-mad when Howie lets him manage the hotel for a day.

programme.title: The Camp Lakebottom Classic
programme.desc: The kids prepare for the last week of camp by volunteering as staff-in-training to help with the unexpected arrival of two new campers. That is, until Buttsquat takes over the camp!

programme.title: Horn Swoggled / The Night Shift
programme.desc: When Narwhal loses his horn, the source of his musical mojo, he switches jobs with Duck. Then, Howie discovers there's a night shift at the Banana Cabana, who have even more fun than the day shift!

programme.title: Escape from Lakebottom
programme.desc: McGee, Gretchen and Squirt arrive at Camp Lakebottom to find themselves held captive by a zombie, a raging Sasquatch and a ruthless chef. Then, McGee and Buttsquat compete to see whose camp is best.

programme.title: The Green Banana / Trash to the Past
programme.desc: Howie attempts to 'go green'... but goes too far. Then, when garbage starts falling out of thin air, Howie and the gang try to figure out why!

programme.title: Late Afternoon of the Living Gitch
programme.desc: When Squirt's stinky underwear is washed in toxic cleanser, the gitch comes alive! Then, a huge, evil leech attaches itself to Squirt's skull and turns him into Evil Squirt.

programme.title: Howie's Pet Project / Dr. Howie and Mr. Howyena
programme.desc: Bunny challenges irresponsible Howie to take care of a pineapple for a single afternoon. Then, Howie concocts a potion that turns him into an obnoxious and hairy! party animal.

programme.title: Jaws of Old Toothy
programme.desc: When Sawyer closes the beach because of a giant, raging fish, McGee vows to rid the lake of 'Old Toothy'. Then, Squirt brings home a baby, monster spider despite Rosebud's ban on pets.

programme.title: Needle Day / Octo vs. Batty
programme.desc: Howie tries to figure out a sneaky way to give nervous Narwhal a needle. Then, Octo and Batty compete to see who can be the most evil, evil minion.

programme.title: Cluck of the Were-Chicken
programme.desc: When a hulking were-chicken stalks the camp, McGee must lead the hunt to prove his innocence. Then, Buttsquat gnome-knaps one of Rosebud's garden gnomes.

programme.title: The Brother and Sister Games / Freebies Jeebies
programme.desc: Poodle reluctantly agrees to be Howie's teammate in a siblings-only competition. Then, Howie's brilliant Banana Cabana coupon plan backfires when too many guests show up at once.

programme.title: Cheeks of Dread
programme.desc: Gretchen must confront her greatest fear when the Bottom Dwellers are trapped on Screech Island. Then, McGee's eagerness for presents almost destroys the biggest monster holiday of the year.

programme.title: A Helping Paw / Howie's Staycation
programme.desc: Howie decides that Sloth needs a personal assistant, so it's up to Howie to find her one. Then, Howie goes on a much-needed vacation - at the Banana Cabana!

programme.title: Marshmallow Madness
programme.desc: Armand goes into a feeding frenzy when wild marshmallows give the campers a rash. Then, McGee and the Bottom Dwellers are hopelessly outnumbered when Suzi moves to Camp Lakebottom.

programme.title: Octo P.I. / The Lost Stunt
programme.desc: While writing his detective novel, Octo uncovers a genuine mystery in the Banana Cabana - the case of the missing spit sock! Then, Howie tries to prove that he's Dirk Danger's number one fan.

programme.title: Pranks for Nothing
programme.desc: Eager to regain his lost prank mojo, McGee releases a mischievous pixy. Then, McGee gets involved in Sawyer's family troubles when he secretly invites Sawyer's estranged mum for a visit.

programme.title: Almost Naked Animals Ep 8
programme.desc: Sloth hypnotises Howie to be 'romantic' and discovers she likes the regular Howie better. Then, Howie tries to help Piggy woo a repulsive warthog.

programme.title: Terror from the Toybox
programme.desc: Buttsquat's Teddy Bear washes up at Camp Lakebottom and hypnotises the Bottom Dwellers. Then, eager to win Buttsquat's awesome new racer, McGee challenges him to cross-Lakebottom race.

programme.title: Octo Gets Tough / Narwhal's Birthday
programme.desc: The newly fearless Octo becomes a little too fearless, even for Howie. Then, Octo and Narwhal discover they're related and try to learn more about each other.

programme.title: Bite of the Buttsquat
programme.desc: No one believes McGee's suspicion that the suddenly ultra-cool Buttsquat is a campyre. Then, during a heat wave, McGee and the gang bring back a glacier.

programme.title: All Night Long / Camp Stinkawahway
programme.desc: Howie and Octo try to stay awake all night long to win Dirk Danger's latest video game. Then, Howie treats the gang to a weekend getaway at Radiation Rooster's haunted campsite.

programme.title: Headless Horse
programme.desc: McGee is thrilled when he wins a mounted horse head. Then, McGee, Gretchen and Squirt discover another camp under the lake.

programme.title: Ducking Duck / Banana Split
programme.desc: Howie discovers that Duck is royalty. Now Duck has to rule over the Banana Cabana. Then, a failed stunt splits the hotel into two halves that are now competing with each other.

programme.title: Pirate of Ickygloomy
programme.desc: While playing Pirates on a shipwreck the Bottom Dwellers must battle the ghost Spitbeard the Pirate. Then, a rare meatball blossom causes Squirt to grow into a giant.

programme.title: Cap'n Fizzy Fizzles / Banned!
programme.desc: Howie tries to help his favourite soda-maker stay in business. Then, Mayor Trout - fed up with Howie and his stunting - BANS Howie.

programme.title: Bloody Marty
programme.desc: The kids ignore Rosebuds warning and summon Bloody Marty from the ominous mirror world. Then, the Bottom Dwellers summon a ghostly Groundskeeper to help take care of their overgrown soccer field.

programme.title: Bumbag Bummer / Dirk Dubious
programme.desc: Sloth becomes famous for her Bumbag, which turns out to cause the dreaded Bumbag disorder! Then, Howie mistakenly thinks he's won a Day with Dirk contest, so Duck pretends to be Dirk.

programme.title: Ants in My Camp
programme.desc: McGee mistakenly concocts a spray that shrinks the campers to a microscopic size. Then, McGee, desperate to win a hovercraft, enters a photo of Armand into a Sasquatch photo contest.

programme.title: Miss Surrounding Area / Campaign Pains
programme.desc: Bunny goes up against Batty - who's disguised as a girl - in the local beauty contest. Then, Howie runs for mayor - then tries his best NOT to get elected when he finds out how much work being mayor i

programme.title: Are You My Mummy?
programme.desc: The Campers and Buttsquat come across an ancient pyramid inhabited by mummy's! Then, something big is lurking in Lake Ickygloomy and causing trouble for Buttssquat...

programme.title: The Rotation Situation
programme.desc: Duck speeds up the rotation of the earth so Howie's birthday will arrive sooner... and makes everyone old! Then, Howie sets out to re-accomplish everything he's ever accomplished... in just one aftern

programme.title: The Superfantastic Mega-Buds
programme.desc: After touching a glowing orb from outer space, McGee, Gretchen and Squirt get super fantastic mega powers! / Then, McGee is sick and confined to his bed.

programme.title: The Big Burp Theory / Who's Howie?
programme.desc: Howie tries not to unleash the world's nastiest burp during his royal thighness Chicken A La King's visit! Then, Howie bonks his head and forgets who he is...

programme.title: High Plains Garbage Eater
programme.desc: It's Western Week at camp and the gang finds themselves in the middle of a good ol' fashioned show down! Then, the Monsters tuck the Campers in to bed and warn them of the Dream Weevil.

programme.title: Inane in the Brain / Laugh Piggy Laugh
programme.desc: Using Duck's latest invention, Octo and Bunny venture inside Howie's brain to retrieve a lost password. Then, Howie and his pals have to help Piggy regain his sense of humour!

programme.title: McGee.T
programme.desc: McGee befriends a frog-like alien creature that crash lands close by Camp Lakebottom. Then, McGee and the gang find an old Tiki Idol that comes to life after McGee plays its bongo drums.

programme.title: Picture Day / Part Timer
programme.desc: Howie tries to help the gang prepare for Staff Picture Day - with disastrous results. Then, Howie tries to find an exciting part-time job so he can be on his favourite TV show 'Hired Hounds.'

programme.title: Camp Plantbottom
programme.desc: It's Suzi's birthday and McGee ate her gift! Desperate to find her another gift McGee grows a mutant plant. Then, the Monsters build an arcade game for the Campers based on Camp Lakebottom.

programme.title: Howie's Allergy / Figure Fight
programme.desc: When Howie is forced to give up sugar, he suddenly becomes a successful stunter and brainiac. Then, Howie and Octo find a one-of-a-kind Dirk Danger action figure and disagree about what to do with it.

programme.title: Clockwork Slime
programme.desc: The Campers find a time travelling clock on the beach and use it to take a trip through Camp Lakebottom's past and future. Then, the Bottom Dwellers come across a haunted cabin ride.

programme.title: Mini Howies / Dear Dirk
programme.desc: Duck gives Howie a batch of mini-Howies - who then go on a rampage with Duck's mini-Ducks. Then, Howie gets the job of answering Dirk's mail and makes a promise to a fan that Dirk can't fulfil!

programme.title: Buttastic Journey
programme.desc: McGee is shrunk down to the size of an atom and accidentally gets slurped up by Buttsquat through his smoothie! Then, Gretchen loses her Kung Fu Chi.

programme.title: These Sleeps Were Made For Walkin'
programme.desc: Octo competes in a sleepwalking tournament to try to win a fancy new bunk bed. Then, a fortune cookie tells Octo and Howie that they need to find new best friends or disaster will befall them.

programme.title: Red Drawn
programme.desc: A travelling salesman visits Lakebottom one rainy day and sells McGee a magic pencil. Then, looking to beat his rivals at the Ickygloomy Slopstical Course Race, McGee summons a Trainer Titan.

programme.title: Don't Follow the Leader / The Snow-tel
programme.desc: Piggy reluctantly helps Howie and Octo finally win a role-playing game of Dirks and Dragons. Then, Batty invokes the Penguin Clause and tries to take over the hotel.

programme.title: 50 Shades of Gretch
programme.desc: In an effort to enter the Camp Sunny Smiles beauty pageant Gretchen looks to connect with her girly side. Then, McGee and Buttsquat battle over who can make the best chili.

programme.title: Luck Be a Robot / Family Business
programme.desc: Howie convinces Bunny to be his lucky charm for the Robot Ruckus tournament. Then, Poodle and Howie have to run a successful business together for one day - or lose their hotels.

programme.title: Valley of the Iguanasquat
programme.desc: When the campers discover a prehistoric valley near Stinky Pits, they also find a cursed gem. Then, a fake treasure hunt between the camps takes a real and dangerous turn.

programme.title: No Howie's Allowed / Howie Day
programme.desc: Octo, Piggy and Narwhal try to keep an overly-excited Howie from ruining Bunny's sleepover. Then, Howie tries to do enough good deeds to convince the mayor he's worthy of his own special day.

programme.title: Adventures in Bottomland
programme.desc: During an unfair polo match, McGee falls down an armadillo and wakes up in Bottomland, a bizarre version of Camp Lakebottom. Then, McGee builds Clayton, a magical clay Golem who follows his commands.

programme.title: Sun Scream / It's Duck's Party
programme.desc: A bad batch of sun screen makes everyone's biggest fears come true. Then, Narwhal has to keep Howie and the others from sneaking into Duck's very exclusive party.

programme.title: S.P.U.D.S
programme.desc: McGee, Gretchen and Squirt accidentally disturb the potato King. Then, McGee summons a 'Monster Hunter,' doppelganger 'Rosebud' from another dimension.

programme.title: Father's Day / Hambo 1: Galactic Super Swine of the Wild West
programme.desc: Duck finds an egg. Thinking it must be his, he excitedly prepares for fatherhood. Then, when Dirk Danger gives up stunting to become a chef, Piggy is chosen to be the next big action movie star.

programme.title: Golfadoom
programme.desc: McGee, Gretchen and Buttsquat must beat Haggis MacJockstrap in a round of golf. Then, McGee convinces Sawyer to spruce up his 'Creepbook' account.

programme.title: It's My Party / One Star Hotel
programme.desc: Howie and the gang get trapped in the basement during the biggest party of the year. Then, the Banana Cabana needs to get one star from a reviewer or Howie will lose the hotel.

programme.title: Eclipsalypso
programme.desc: McGee summons the Moon Dervish who will bring the Apocalypse unless a sasquatch dances for him. Then, McGee and Squirt have a falling out.

programme.title: There Are No Small Parts
programme.desc: Howie auditions to become Dirk Danger's new movie sidekick - but Octo gets the job! Then, Howie finds a lost toy that - when you add water to it - becomes a monster truck!

programme.title: Itchy Witchy Pizza Project
programme.desc: Gretchen, McGee and Squirt get trapped by witch who forces the campers into pizza slave labour. Then, Suzi gives Buttsquat a rare action figure that was sent in a care package meant for McGee.

programme.title: Ear Wax Elf / Stunter's Block
programme.desc: Howie must be extra nice to his pals so that the Ear Wax Elf will leave him a gift for his latest blob of wax. Then, Howie quits the hotel biz to try to lure his hero Dirk Danger out of retirement.

programme.title: Scare-A-Normal-Activity
programme.desc: McGee vows to protect Lakebottom's supernatural secrets from the prying host. Then, the campers befriend Poe, an elderly, former Lakebottom camper.

programme.title: What Would Batty Do?
programme.desc: When Howie injures Batty in a stunting accident, he takes over as Poodle's assistant while Batty recuperates at the Banana Cabana. Then, thinking he has psychic predictive powers, Poodle kidnaps Duck.

programme.title: Big Top Terror
programme.desc: The campers summon Armand's old rival, Doofus the Clown, who vows to destroy the campers. Then, McGee prepares the 'best prank ever'.

programme.title: Employee Of The Month For Life / Saliva Drive
programme.desc: Howie does everyone's jobs - to help him decide who should be Employee of the Month. Then, Howie and the staff collect saliva for Octo, whose tongue has dried up.

programme.title: Who's Ghouling Who?
programme.desc: Eager to take the 'Scare and Freak Champ' title from Gretchen, McGee accidentally summons Percy, a ghost with a very 'fiery' personality. Then, the Bottomdwellers film Armand's horror masterpiece.

programme.title: Veggie Beast / Hurricane Seasoning
programme.desc: Howie has to save the hotel from an overgrown, animal-swallowing plant. Then, a condiment storm is coming, and all of Howie's pals are trapped outside.
